objective: The owner's word of 2026-11-26 ("Let's do 1, 2, and 3") on the three directions of the report that closed FAMILIES-THAT-MEET-20261126-001: (1) a bench that joins two of the record's lasting patterns (the ring that returns, the part that copies itself, the source that releases families) in one start, one to three steps apart, under waiting and under laws that reach further, and reads whether either one's course differs from growing without the other, and for how long; (2) the same bench as a toy on the site, so that the owner can run it; (3) a search of small starts for pairs that act on each other. Stop at a pair of patterns one of which still changes the other's course late in the growth, under a law that uses no names and under a swap of ration, or when every pair has been read.
status: Complete 2026-11-26 (successful as a search, its stop not met; referee pending): three lasting patterns and 990 pairs of small starts joined two at a time under laws that use no names; no mark in the other is first heard by a pattern's own knots after round 6 (2,441 bench cases, 17,809 census cases); under the ordinary count no new knot is short, so by a meeting a pattern's own knots cannot feel the other; the toy is live at prespatial.org/playground/two-patterns.
title: Two lasting patterns in one start: does one keep changing the other
